description: This file defines the interface 'LanguageManagerInterface' for managing language-related functionalities in Drupal, including retrieving current, default, and available languages, as well as language fallbacks and switch links.

classes.name: LanguageManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for language management in Drupal, providing methods for language retrieval, fallback, switch links, and configuration overrides.

methods.name: isMultilingual
methods.description: Checks if the site has more than one language added.

methods.name: getLanguageTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of available language types.

methods.name: getDefinedLanguageTypesInfo
methods.description: Provides information about all defined language types.

methods.name: getCurrentLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the current language object for a specified type.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the specified or all language types.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the site's default language object.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Lists all languages set up on the site, filtered by flags.

methods.name: getNativeLanguages
methods.description: Lists all site languages in their native form, ordered by weight and name.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a language object based on a language code.

methods.name: getLanguageName
methods.description: Produces the display name for a language.

methods.name: getDefaultLockedLanguages
methods.description: Lists default locked languages starting from a specified weight.

methods.name: isLanguageLocked
methods.description: Checks if a language is locked.

methods.name: getFallbackCandidates
methods.description: Provides fallback language codes based on context.

methods.name: getLanguageSwitchLinks
methods.description: Generates language switch links for a given type and URL.

methods.name: setConfigOverrideLanguage
methods.description: Sets a language to override configuration.

methods.name: getConfigOverrideLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration override language.

methods.name: getStandardLanguageList
methods.description: Returns a list of common languages with English and native names.
